# dengueriskcdmx

Data, rasters and code for supporting the **Risk Map of Dengue
Transmission in the Metropolitan Area of Mexico City**.

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("fdzul/dengueriskcdmx")
```

## What is included

| Object | Description |
|----|----|
| `ae_aegypti_2017_2024` | *Ae. aegypti* ovitrap presences and pseudo-absences, 2017-2024, with the `split` column (train / test) |
| `ae_aegypti_2017_2024_train` | Training partition (80%) |
| `ae_aegypti_2017_2024_test` | Test partition (20%) |
| `ae_aegypti_2025` | External validation data, 2025 |
| `aoi` | Study area (Mexico City Metropolitan Area) |

Each data set has the class (`presence` / `pseudoabs`), nine predictors
(`built`, `tree`, `ndvi`, `prcp`, `ia`, `ice`, `im`, `pop`, `hfp`) and
the point geometry. The partition is 80/20, stratified by class, with
seed 12345.

The Quarto code of the machine-learning workflow
(`ml_code_ae_aegypti.qmd` and `ml_code_dengue.qmd`) is provided as
vignettes.

Three rasters (about 500 m) are shipped in `inst/extdata`, all derived
from the consensus (mean of the probabilities) of Random Forest,
LightGBM and XGBoost models:

| `layer`    | Raster                                         |
|------------|------------------------------------------------|
| `"aedes"`  | Probability of *Ae. aegypti* occurrence        |
| `"dengue"` | Probability of confirmed imported dengue cases |
| `"risk"`   | Five-level epidemiological risk                |

## Example

``` r
library(dengueriskcdmx)

# ovitrap data
table(ae_aegypti_2017_2024$class)

# rasters (requires the terra package)
r <- ae_raster("aedes")
terra::plot(r)
```

## Data availability

The ovitrap data are included. The data on confirmed dengue cases used
to fit the case model are **not** published; only the derived
probability and risk rasters are provided.

## Dashboard

An interactive version of the maps is available at
<https://eclectic-alfajores-088839.netlify.app/>.

## Citation

Dzul-Manzanilla F, Correa-Morales F. Risk Map of Dengue Transmission in
the Metropolitan Area of Mexico City (under review).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ae_aegypti_2017_2024`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/ae_aegypti_2017_2024.md)
  : Aedes aegypti ovitrap data, 2017-2024 (full database)
- [`ae_aegypti_2017_2024_test`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/ae_aegypti_2017_2024_test.md)
  : Aedes aegypti test partition, 2017-2024
- [`ae_aegypti_2017_2024_train`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/ae_aegypti_2017_2024_train.md)
  : Aedes aegypti training partition, 2017-2024
- [`ae_aegypti_2025`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/ae_aegypti_2025.md)
  : Aedes aegypti external validation data, 2025
- [`ae_raster()`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/ae_raster.md)
  : Read a raster shipped with the package
- [`ae_raster_path()`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/ae_raster_path.md)
  : Path to a raster shipped with the package
- [`aoi`](https://fdzul.github.io/dengueriskcdmx/reference/aoi.md) :
  Study area
